evidence.detail: Title "LocknLock | Healthy kitchen life together with LocknLock"; description missing; 561 words; 1 H1

evidence.label: Structured data
evidence.detail: No JSON-LD found on the pages read

evidence.detail: No price in the text; no contact details in the text

evidence.label: Pages read

evidence.label: Audit score
evidence.detail: 54/100 on 39 checks

evidence.label: robots.txt
evidence.detail: FAIL: There is no robots.txt (HTTP 404). Fix: Serve a plain-text /robots.txt (RFC 9309) with at least one User-agent group and a Sitemap line.

evidence.label: Content Signals
evidence.detail: WARN: No robots.txt, so there's nowhere to declare Content Signals. Fix: Add a Content-Signal line to robots.txt (for example `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no`) to state how AI systems may use your content.

evidence.label: Markdown via Accept Header
evidence.detail: FAIL: No sampled page serves markdown when asked with `Accept: text/markdown` (4 pages checked). Fix: Return a markdown version of each page when a request sends `Accept: text/markdown`, with `Vary: Accept` so caches keep the two apart.

evidence.label: Markdown at .md URLs
evidence.detail: FAIL: No sampled page serves markdown at a `.md` URL (3 pages checked). Fix: Serve each page's markdown at the same path with `.md` appended (and `/index.md` for the homepage).

evidence.label: llms.txt
evidence.detail: FAIL: /llms.txt returned HTTP 404 with an HTML page. Fix: Publish /llms.txt as described at llmstxt.org: an H1 with the site name, a `>` summary, and sections of annotated markdown links.

evidence.label: Sitemap
evidence.detail: FAIL: No valid sitemap at https://locknlock.com/sitemap.xml (HTTP 404). Fix: Publish an XML sitemap listing your canonical pages, and reference it from robots.txt with a Sitemap line.

evidence.label: Discovery Link Headers
evidence.detail: WARN: The homepage sends no discovery Link header. Fix: Add an HTTP Link header (RFC 8288) to the homepage pointing at your sitemap, llms.txt (`rel="describedby"`), and markdown alternate.

evidence.label: Organization Structured Data
evidence.detail: FAIL: The homepage has no Organization JSON-LD. Fix: Add Organization JSON-LD to the homepage with name, url, logo, description, and contactPoint or address.

evidence.label: Entity Links (sameAs)
evidence.detail: FAIL: The Organization has no sameAs links. Fix: List your official profiles (LinkedIn, GitHub, Crunchbase, Wikipedia, X) in the Organization's `sameAs`, so models tie your site to the right entity.

evidence.label: Page Structured Data
evidence.detail: FAIL: Sampled pages have no content-level structured data. Fix: Mark up pages with the schema.org type that fits them: Article or BlogPosting, Product or SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, HowTo, BreadcrumbList.

evidence.label: Page Metadata
evidence.detail: FAIL: meta description missing on 2 pages, canonical missing on 4 pages, and og:type missing on 4 pages. Fix: Give every page a unique title, a meta description, a canonical link, `<html lang>`, and og:image and og:type.

evidence.label: Content Freshness
evidence.detail: WARN: None of the sampled pages says when it was published or updated. Fix: State when each page was published and last updated: `datePublished` and `dateModified` in JSON-LD (or `article:modified_time`), and keep them accurate. Answer engi

evidence.label: About, Contact, and Privacy Pages
evidence.detail: WARN: contact isn't linked and privacy isn't linked. Fix: Link About, Contact, and Privacy pages from the homepage. Agents use them to judge who is behind a site.

evidence.label: Document Structure
evidence.detail: WARN: 4 of 4 pages have structure issues (skipped heading levels and more than one H1). Fix: Wrap the main content in `<main>`, use one H1 per page, and don't skip heading levels.

headline: Missing crawl files and structured data keep AI assistants from understanding LocknLock.

findings.title: Missing crawl and discovery files
findings.why: AI crawlers have no robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt, or Link headers to discover pages and usage rules.
findings.fix: Publish plain-text /robots.txt, an XML sitemap, and /llms.txt, and reference them via Link headers.

findings.title: No structured data or entity links
findings.why: Without JSON-LD, sameAs links, or page schema, AI models cannot verify the business entity or its offerings.
findings.fix: Add Organization JSON-LD with sameAs links to the homepage and schema.org markup to content pages.

findings.title: Incomplete metadata and heading structure
findings.why: Missing meta descriptions, canonicals, og:type tags, and skipped heading levels make pages harder for AI to parse.
findings.fix: Add unique titles, meta descriptions, canonical links, og:type tags, and one H1 per page inside <main>.

findings.title: Missing prices, contact details, and trust links
findings.why: AI assistants cannot quote prices or verify who runs the site when contact and privacy links are missing.
findings.fix: Include prices and contact details in page text and link Contact and Privacy pages from the homepage.

findings.title: No publication or update dates
findings.why: Without published or modified dates, AI assistants cannot tell whether the page content is current.
findings.fix: Add accurate datePublished and dateModified metadata to each page.

strengths.title: Homepage has a clear title, 561 words, and one H1
Core brand, history, and award pages are readable
